parts:
I am trying to use MSstats to impute missing values in the PRIDE dataset PXD014525. This dataset was processed with MaxQuant and all of the requisite MSstats input files are present on PRIDE. The column names of this output dataframe are Protein and NA_NA (shown below, right). 

             

I'd like to generate an imputed matrix where rows are proteins and columns are runs. What is going wrong here? 
Thanks

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: NA_NA field after `quantification`
parts:
Hello,

I dug into this problem and was able to build the annotation file given the MaxQ evidence file. I think your problem was the Run name in your annotation did not match the full MaxQ run name. The code below creates the annotation file that works for me.

```
library(tidyverse)

substrRight <- function(x, n){
    substr(x, nchar(x)-n+1, nchar(x))
}

annot = evidence %>% distinct(`Raw file`, Experiment)
annot$BioReplicate = unlist(lapply(annot$Experiment, function(x){substrRight(x,2)}))
annot = annot %>% mutate(BioReplicate = str_replace(BioReplicate, "E", ""))
annot$BioReplicate = as.integer(annot$BioReplicate)

annot$Condition = substr(annot$Experiment,1,nchar(annot$Experiment)-3)
```

Hope this helps!

Devon
